title: On Brauer groups of known Enriques manifolds
summary: We compute the Brauer group of some of the known Enriques manifolds. We then build special Brauer-Severi varieties on these manifolds and study the pull-back map from the Brauer group of an Enriques manifold to that of its hyper-Kähler universal cover, from both a geometric and an algebraic perspective.
